source.final_only_changes: Post-measurement edits affect only test assertions/comments (including the 22-grain fallback assertion), fixture README, and inspector SVG labels. Runtime source is unchanged; inspector was rebuilt separately.

profile: release / fat LTO / one codegen unit
notes: Both versions are uncommitted follow-ups on 52f9e18. Baseline is the previously deployed supported-frontier and failed-retry-memoization pass, identified by per-file and executable hashes. No PR was changed.

The established ordinary and broad-recovery plans run first. Only unused budget may try narrower exclusion of the closest edit to a blocked surface tile. A valid broader recovery remains a fallback; a targeted recovery replaces it only if more grains fit.

The total remains 64 candidate grains per tick, eight surface-plan slots per group, and 1.75/1.25-cell movement limits. Recovery still requires 1.5 seconds quiet. Identical assignments within one immutable query reuse clearance/repose assessment but still consume a slot; at most eight assessments exist.

32 serial final comparison executions: 20 desktop and 12 Picade. These are single paired runs, not a replicated performance distribution. Desktop explores Scorched seeds 42, 4242 and 777; Picade repeats seed 42.

Scorched runs last 120 simulated seconds with 60 seconds bombardment, 192 grains, auditing and full replay. Timing excludes diagnostics, capture, replay and rendering. Spacewars runs last 30 seconds and include combat/match in both shapes plus loose-off controls.

Picade kiosk pause is checked before and after every run. Telemetry endpoints are temperature in millidegrees C, CPU0 frequency in kHz and undervoltage alarm. Endpoint frequency does not rule out intervening thermal throttling. Interpret timing as an observed device comparison, not controlled-clock microbenchmarking.

All Scorched runs conserve their initial cell counts and replay; both games match final desktop/Picade hashes. Spacewars loose-off controls are unchanged. Enabled grains can change trajectories even with collapse off.

All six revised Scorched collapse-enabled runs stop releasing additional material during the last 30 seconds. This pass has mixed final loose counts and costs; targeted small-case improvements are not a universal whole-scene speedup.

Every final desktop candidate outcome matches the corresponding pre-optimization executable without within-query assessment reuse. That experiment is retained under target/dirt-actor-review/full-refinement-desktop.
One extra before Spacewars collapse-on run was excluded when DNS failed during its post-run state check; the final pair was rerun with complete pause and telemetry records.

The new 50-grain frozen fixture still accepts zero with tank 11 present and all 50 when only that tank is omitted. This is evidence of influence, not a proof that no tank-present solution exists. Three-grain tests exhaustively distinguish true lack of space from missed placements.

validation.clippy: Strict --no-deps passes for engine-rapier and Scorched; including dependencies hits an existing nonminimal_bool in unchanged engine-terrain/src/additions.rs.
